scope.purpose: Determine whether public first-party Bitget metadata authoritatively links each perp to an underlying primary exchange, MIC, timezone and historically stable identity, and identify official candidate exchange calendar sources for the saved interval.
out_of_scope: Inferring exchange linkage from issuer, ISIN, region or ticker

verified_claims: The current public Bitget API classifies all four selected symbols as online USDT futures, perpetual, stock instruments, with US marketRegion and issuer/ISIN metadata.
Bitget's published field descriptions define marketRegion as a region code and ISIN as a security identifier; the published schema does not assert exchange, MIC or timezone.
Nasdaq and NYSE official pages provide 2026 holiday/hours information; their calendars are candidate references only, not verified per-symbol mappings.
missing_claims: No authoritative Bitget source mapping each symbol to its underlying primary exchange and MIC.
No authoritative Bitget source naming the exchange timezone or session calendar for these perps.
No point-in-time mapping or history proving the underlying identity did not change during the saved interval.
No basis to assign a specific official holiday/early-close calendar to any of the four symbols.
result.next_official_request: Ask Bitget Reality Stock/Stock+ product support or documentation for a symbol-level reference-market specification for AAPLUSDT, TSLAUSDT, NVDAUSDT and COINUSDT, including primary exchange name, MIC, timezone, reference/index source and effective-from/effective-to or change history for 2026-09-17 through 2026-11-01. Only after Bitget confirms the mapping, apply the linked exchange's official historical calendar and verify all scheduled closures and early closes within that interval.
result.data_gate: Keep session labels and any session-performance comparison blocked for all four symbols until the exchange/MIC/timezone link and historical validity are authoritative.
